No live moment

Free courses don’t sell the room

Your free 7-day series is self-paced. Nobody gets the energy of you live, the thing your stage audiences pay for, before they decide to buy a course or call you.

Stop-start

The $97 challenge only opens sometimes

Recruit 10 in 10 opens “only occasionally”. Between rounds, the easiest paid yes in your business has no door, so revenue comes in bursts instead of every week.

No filter

Coaching starts with a text

Your coaching page asks for budget, from $1,000 up to $100,000, but the “Let’s Go, Coach!” button doesn’t link anywhere yet. Serious buyers and tyre-kickers both land in your WhatsApp.

The leaders and top earners who want you in their corner are already watching your reels. There’s no live moment yet that lets them raise their hand.

My recommendation

A free live masterclass, Ten Times Bolder Prospecting, that sells your challenge every week and finds your next coaching clients

You already have paid products, so the class itself should be free. Your $97 Recruit 10 in 10 Challenge moves to the thank-you page as an always-open offer (the daily sessions are already recorded), it earns from day one and helps pay for the ads, and the replay page sends the serious ones to an application.
